Name: Expanded Forest Farm by Koko
Author: KokoroIppai
Description:
[img]https://imgur.com/GZsjOF6.png[/img]
[font=Verdana][size=2]Expanded Forest Farm by Koko is a larger version of the Forest Farm! It keeps the perks of the Forest Farm (farm foragables and regenerating stumps) while also giving the player more space to make their farming empire!
This mod adds an expansion to the right side of the farm map and also includes a few new secrets to discover. Along with the increased map size, all grass and dirt tiles on the map are tillable for more freedom over crop placement.

[b][i]This mod is only compatible with Stardew Valley v1.6+ on PC.[/i][/b]

[b]To Install:[/b]
1) Download and install all required mods.
2) Unzip the downloaded mod file in to your StardewValley/mods folder.
3) Run the game using SMAPI and start a new save on the Forest Farm![/size][/font]

Downloads.Description: Remade for SDV v1.6! Houses should be moveable without texture and invisible barrier issues! There are some slight visual changes to some dirt tiles on the eastern side of the farm.
